text:
This clinic provides consultations for health problems related to our daily activities, such as working from home leading to office syndrome, incorrect exercise postures causing muscle pain and stiffness, or even long-distance driving that negatively affects back and abdominal muscles.

I received acupressure treatment, a manual therapy method performed by a skilled and experienced physiotherapist who understands the connections between various muscle pain and stiffness. After approximately two months of consistent treatment, my stiffness and pain significantly decreased.

The clinic's physiotherapist also guided me on correct exercise techniques, stretching, and practical daily routines to prevent muscle injury and strengthen muscles, in conjunction with acupressure therapy.

I recommend that anyone unsure whether they should consider physiotherapy try consulting with the clinic first. I believe the clinic can recommend a treatment and self-care program tailored to each individual's needs.
